lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Roughly grid-like distribution of circular high-luminance spots extending from the posterior head region along the mid-dorsal and lateral surfaces.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting horizontal rows of spots to form a tessellated grid pattern most prominent in the mid-body region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Faint longitudinal linear features visible along the upper flank, showing a subtle dark-to-light vertical gradient indicating structural ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated symbiotic organisms positioned ventrally and laterally near the pectoral fin.
